## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Verification

List checks you actually ran and any remaining gaps.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the affected behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and environment examples are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private targets, runtime files, or real scan results are included.
- [ ] UI screenshots, when applicable, contain only synthetic data.
- [ ] Deployment and compatibility implications are described.
